institution.name: Mohammed Bin Rashid University of Medicine and Health Sciences (MBRU)

qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a biological sciences discipline with a minimum cGPA of 3.00/4.00 (2.5-2.99 may receive conditional admission)
English proficiency (IELTS or TOEFL; TOEFL iBT minimum 80)

description_short: MBRU's two-year, full-time Master of Science in Biomedical Sciences in Dubai is accepting applications for 2027-28 from October 12, 2026 until July 12, 2027, with interviews on July 19, 2027. Early submissions receive priority.
